title: cellxgene_census
description:
Query cells from a CellxGene Census or custom TileDBSoma object.
Aside from fetching the cells' RNA counts (`.X`), cell metadata
(`.obs`) and gene metadata (`.var`), this component also fetches
the dataset metadata and joins it into the cell metadata.

dataset input.title: Dataset input
dataset input.description: Dataset input using nf-tower "dataset" or "data explorer". Allows for the input of multiple parameter sets to initialise a Nextflow channel.

param_list.description: Dataset input can either be a list of maps, a csv file, a json file, a yaml file, or simply a yaml blob. The names of the input fields (e.g. csv columns, json keys) need to be an exact match with the workflow input parameters.

input database.title: Input database
input database.description: Open CellxGene Census by version or URI.

input_uri.description: If specified, a URI containing the Census SOMA objects. If specified, will take precedence over the `--census_version` argument.

census_version.description: Which release of CellxGene census to use. Possible values are "latest", "stable", or the date of one of the releases (e.g. "2023-07-25"). For more information, check the documentation on [Census data releases](https://chanzuckerberg.github.io/cellxgene-census/cellxgene_census_docsite_data_release_info.html).

add_dataset_metadata.description: If true, the experiment metadata will be added to the cell metadata. More specifically: `collection_id`, `collection_name`, `collection_doi`, `dataset_title`.

species.description: The organism to query, usually one of `Homo sapiens` or `Mus musculus`.

obs_value_filter.description: Filter for selecting the `obs` metadata (i.e. cells). Value is a filter query written in the SOMA `value_filter` syntax.
obs_value_filter.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, example: `["is_primary_data == True and cell_type_ontology_term_id in ['CL:0000136', 'CL:1000311', 'CL:0002616'] and suspension_type == 'cell'"]`

filter cells by grouping.title: Filter cells by grouping
filter cells by grouping.description: Filter groups with fewer than X number of cells.

cell_filter_grouping.description:
A subset of 'obs' columns by which to group the cells for filtering.
Only groups surpassing or equal to the `--cell_filter_minimum_count`
threshold will be retained. Take care not to introduce a selection
bias against cells with more fine-grained ontology annotations.

cell_filter_minimum_count.description:
A minimum number of cells per group to retain. If `--cell_filter_grouping`
is defined, this parameter should also be provided and vice versa.

count filtering.title: Count filtering
count filtering.description: Arguments related to filtering cells and genes by counts.

cell_filter_min_genes.description: Remove cells with less than this number of genes.

cell_filter_min_counts.description: Remove cells with less than this number of counts.

gene_filter_min_cells.description: Remove genes expressed in less than this number of cells.

gene_filter_min_counts.description: Remove genes with less than this number of counts.

output.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `output`, example: `['output.h5mu']`

output_modality.description: Which modality to store the output in.

output_layer_counts.description: Which layer to store the raw counts in. If not provided, the .X layer will be used.

output_compression.description:
Compression format to use for the output AnnData and/or Mudata H5 files.
By default no compression is applied.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
